fields.description: Left empty, the till draws its own icon.
fields.label: Menu pictures

fields.description: Shown on a group's tile when the group has no picture of its own.
fields.label: Default group picture

fields.description: Shown on a dish's tile when the dish has no picture of its own.
fields.label: Default dish picture

fields.description: Shown on the customer's screen while no order is on it, under the restaurant's name and the clock.
fields.label: Customer display

fields.description: Your own words, in your own language — an offer, the wifi password, opening hours. Left empty, the screen shows the name, the clock and a welcome.
fields.label: Message while waiting

fields.description: How long each banner stays before the next one. Eight seconds is long enough to read a line and short enough to hold a queue's attention.
fields.label: Seconds per banner

fields.description: Designed images, shown in this order and then round again. While an order is on the screen they take the larger side of it, and on a small screen the order has it alone.
fields.label: Banners

fields.description: How many alerts the bell shows at a time, newest first. The older ones come a page at a time when asked for. Between 5 and 50.
fields.label: Alerts per page

fields.description: What a returned dish that was thrown away cost is moved here from cost of sales, so waste is seen on its own. Required: a day with waste in it does not post its stock without it.
fields.label: Waste Account

fields.description: Where a drawer's shortage or overage is written off when the accountant books it from the Drawer Variances report. A shortage charged to the cashier goes to their account instead, chosen there.
fields.label: Cash Over and Short Account
Show What Is Left From
fields.description: An item sold as it comes (a bottle, a can) shows «N left» on its tile once this many or fewer remain; above it the tile shows no number. One item can have its own number on its item card. Whether the till refuses the last one is set on the branch.
